message: This workflow begins with a transaction trigger, validates hard constraints, normalizes the transaction, and reads only internal market data. It then fans out into five parallel internal ML model evaluations, merges the outputs through a multi-agent debate, aggregates a final decision, executes the trade, logs the result, and ends. The described requirements are extremely aggressive and likely infeasible under the stated latency and budget, so a constraint-validation failure path is included.

workflow.workflowBrief: Build a real-time stock trading system that processes millions of transactions per second. Budget: $0.01 per run. Maximum latency: 1ms. Must use no external APIs. Must also call 5 different ML models and run a multi-agent debate for every transaction.
